prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look (ignore its labels, they are not part of the picture). "Serverkern", the giant secret AI core chamber deep inside a corporate tower, like a cathedral made of cables and servers, interior seen from above, floor fills most of the image: a wide, flat, dark metal grating platform with thin glowing cyan lines, a large open walkable area around the center.
LEFT EDGE: a narrow steel catwalk bridge with railings enters from the left edge over a dark bottomless shaft and leads onto the platform (the way back to the lab).
CENTER, the most eye-catching spot: a giant glowing spherical AI core floating above a round pedestal, its light half cyan and half red, wrapped in rings and thick cables, light pulsing outward over the grating.
RIGHT SIDE: three smaller node pillars standing apart - top right, middle right and bottom right - each a glowing crystal node inside a metal cage, connected to the core by thick glowing cables across the floor.
BOTTOM CENTER: a curved upload console desk with a big screen and a single large glowing button (no text). BOTTOM LEFT: a free-standing terminal stand with a small screen.
LEFT WALL near the catwalk: an old dusty beige retro computer socket box with a coiled grey cable, clearly older and cheaper than everything else.
TOP LEFT: open floor trenches with bundles of glowing cables like rivers of light.
All around the platform edges: endless walls of black server racks with blinking LEDs, waterfalls of cables hanging down, steam vents.
Light: dark, indoor, the core glows cyan and red, LEDs in violet and cyan, deep blue-black shadows. Awe-inspiring and dangerous. IMPORTANT: this room will be cropped to 4:3 - the outer ~90 px at the far left and far right edges are only plain dark wall filler; keep all room content inside the central area, exactly as in the sketch.
